heading.title: Incorporation of Limited Liability Partnership and Matters Incidental Thereto

article.title: Change of registered name.
article.content:
19Change of registered name.

Section 19  ·  Chapter III  ·  page 11 of the Act
Any limited liability partnership may change its name registered with the Registrar by filing with him a notice of such change in such form and manner and on payment of such fees as may be prescribed.
